policy_presence.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Acknowledge assistance and reference external material in taught assessed coursework.

coursework.summary: For 2026/27 taught assessed coursework, assistance is normally permitted unless the brief restricts it; technology must support your own learning. Paid services are prohibited, with a Disability Services exception.

exams.summary: Examinations are governed by their own assessment format and instructions; no general AI permission is inferred.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The current data-upload permission by role and data class requires further verification.

academic_integrity.summary: The 2026/27 guidance requires acknowledgement; Schools do not use AI detectors to identify misconduct.

approved_tools.summary: University-licensed Copilot availability requires current account-level confirmation and does not grant assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: No accepted current canonical conclusion is established here; local evidence candidates and original tool records remain pending review.

teaching_guidance.summary: Tutors set any justified restrictions in assessment briefs for taught assessed coursework.

research_guidance.summary: The taught-coursework policy includes taught PGR components; it does not establish permission for non-taught research or publication. Check the applicable PGR rules.

security_procurement.summary: Procurement and information-security approval have not been verified for current products.
